integrity: One precise finite theorem is supported by complete reproducible Python 3 code and a written exhaustive-enumeration bijection. No external independent audit has been conducted. An equivalent unindexed tabulation remains possible.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for cyclic binary order-five de Bruijn words; no extension to other orders, no claims about physical channel performance. Enumeration is a finite graph proof with two independently implemented coverage methods, not a probabilistic simulation.
title: Exact periodic autocorrelation-energy spectrum of binary order-five de Bruijn cycles
